notes.title: Second game in A Summer with the Shiba Inu series is back
notes.content: [p][/p][p]Hello everyone, this is Quill Studios, developer of Autumn with the Shiba Inu and A Summer with the Shiba Inu. Thank you so much for believing in Autumn with the Shiba Inu when we ran our Kickstarter in 2023. Unfortunately, we had to cancel the crowdfunding, as it was clear that we were not able to reach our goal.[/p][p][/p][p]We made the difficult decision to pay out of pocket to ensure the release of this game. This unfortunately meant that we had to cut most of the staff: while their contracts concluded, we were unable to renew them. As a result, progress has been slow, as our core team's day jobs and financial responsibilities come first, and the game second.[/p][p][/p][p]Despite these setbacks, our team has been working part-time to make progress on the game, and the game is very close to release! We are committed to releasing in August, 2025. This is shorter notice than we'd like, as we're losing out on precious time to further market and promote the game to recoup the costs of development and finish paying our staff. However, this is the most feasible date for our skeleton crew as they juggle other life obligations to pay bills.[/p][p][/p][p]With this, we have a plea: While we don't have the bandwidth to do another Kickstarter, purchasing Autumn with the Shiba Inu would help so much with recouping the costs and finish paying our staff, which allows us to continue to make more games in the future![/p][p][/p][p]Please, wishlist the game on Steam which helps us with visibility and will notify you of the release date when announced![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2182990/Autumn_with_the_Shiba_Inu/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Endings guide updated - let us know if it helped!
notes.content:
Hi all,

We've put some effort into making an achievements guide for A Summer with the Shiba Inu.

A big disclaimer: there are MANY ways to get most of the achievements, and some of the logic is non-linear. As such, you can stumble upon endings without following the guide completely, if at all. For convenience, I've tried to include one possible way to get an achievement in the clearest way possible.

There are actually some ending variations that do not have an associated achievement, and might not be included in this guide. We encourage you to explore them as well, because there are more dialogue and backstory to be uncovered about the dogs!

Here is the guide:

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1873462001

Again, do let us know if there are any achievements that you are stuck on even with this guide - we will definitely update as soon as possible!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/916030/A_Summer_with_the_Shiba_Inu/
